original.target_description: Study 2, European American versus Korean university students: planned comparison of preference for unique subfigures. The supplied page and study identify this study but do not uniquely select among its multiple tests.

n.sample_role: University student participants; the Method reports 38 European Americans and 38 Koreans, but does not explicitly identify an analytic sample after exclusions for the selected test.
n.exclusions: Not documented for this comparison; no analytic n inferred from degrees of freedom.
n.location: Printed p. 789 (article p. 5; PDF p. 6), Study 2, Method, Participants
n.quote: Thirty-eight European American students (17 men and 21 women) from Stanford University and 38 Korean students (14 men and 24 women) from Soongsil University in Seoul, South Korea, filled out the questionnaire.

es.location: Printed p. 789 (article p. 5; PDF p. 6), Study 2, Results, planned comparisons
es.quote: Planned comparisons showed that liking for the unique subfigures differed between European Americans (M = 5.88, SD = 2.11) and Koreans (M = 3.81, SD = 1.91), t(74) = 4.55, p < .01.
